verses.text: Jehoshaphat, king of Judah, return to im house for Jerusalem in peace.

Jehu, Hanani pikin, di seer, go out to meet am and talk to King Jehoshaphat say, “You suppose help wicked people and love dem wey hate di Lord? Because of dis thing, anger dey on you from before di Lord.
Still, good things dey find for you, because you don remove di Asherah poles from di land and set your heart to look for God.”
Jehoshaphat dey stay for Jerusalem, and e go out again among di people from Beersheba reach Ephraim hill country and bring dem back to di Lord, di God of dem papa dem.
E put judges for di land, for all di strong cities of Judah, city by city,
and talk to di judges say, “Think well about wetin una dey do, because una no dey judge for man, but for di Lord, and e dey with una for di judgment.
So now make di fear of di Lord dey on una. Take care and do am, because wickedness no dey with di Lord our God, and e no dey favor anybody or collect bribe.”
For Jerusalem too Jehoshaphat put some of di Levites and di priests, and some of di heads of di papa dem houses of Israel, for di judgment of di Lord and for quarrels. Dem return go Jerusalem.
E command dem say, “Na so una go do for di fear of di Lord, faithfully and with perfect heart.

Anytime quarrel come to una from una brothers wey dey stay for dem cities, between blood and blood, between law and command, laws and rules, una go warn dem so that dem no go be guilty before di Lord, and anger no go come on una and on una brothers. Do dis one, and una no go be guilty.

Look, Amariah di chief priest dey over una for all matters of di Lord, and Zebadiah, Ishmael pikin, di ruler of Judah house, for all di king matters. Di Levites go be officers before una too. Act with courage, and make di Lord dey with di good.”
E happen after dis say Moab pikin dem, Ammon pikin dem, and some of di Ammonites with dem come against Jehoshaphat for battle.
Some people come tell Jehoshaphat say, “Big crowd dey come against you from di other side of di sea, from Syria, and look, dem dey Hazazon Tamar, wey be Engedi.”
Jehoshaphat fear and set imself to look for di Lord, and e announce fasting for all Judah.
Judah gather together to ask help from di Lord. Dem come from all di cities of Judah to look for di Lord.
Jehoshaphat stand for di gathering of Judah and Jerusalem, for di Lord house, before di new court,
and talk say, “Di Lord, di God of our papa dem, no be you be God for heaven? No be you rule over all di kingdoms of di nations? Power and might dey your hand, so tay nobody fit stand against you.
No be you, our God, drive out di people wey dey stay for dis land before your people Israel, and give am to Abraham your friend pikin dem forever?
Dem stay inside am, and dem don build sanctuary for your name inside am, say,
‘If evil come on us, sword, judgment, plague or hunger, we go stand before dis house and before you, because your name dey dis house, and cry to you for our trouble, and you go hear and save us.’
Now look, Ammon pikin dem, Moab and Mount Seir, wey you no let Israel enter when dem comot from Egypt land, but dem turn away from dem and no destroy dem,
look how dem dey pay us back, to come drive us out of your possession wey you don give us to inherit.
Our God, you no go judge dem? Because we no get power against dis big crowd wey dey come against us, and we no know wetin we go do, but our eyes dey on you.”
All Judah stand before di Lord, with dem small pikin dem, dem wives and dem pikin dem.
Den di Spirit of di Lord come on Jahaziel, Zechariah pikin, Benaiah pikin, Jeiel pikin, Mattaniah pikin, one Levite from Asaph pikin dem, for di middle of di gathering,

and e talk say, “Listen, all Judah, and una wey dey stay for Jerusalem, and you, King Jehoshaphat. Dis na wetin di Lord talk to una: ‘No fear and no shake because of dis big crowd, because di battle no be una own, but God own.
Tomorrow go down against dem. Look, dem dey come up by di climb of Ziz, and una go find dem for di end of di valley, before di wilderness of Jeruel.

Una no need to fight for dis battle. Stand firm, stand still and see di salvation of di Lord with una, Judah and Jerusalem. No fear and no shake. Tomorrow go out against dem, because di Lord dey with una.’”
Jehoshaphat bow im head with im face to di ground, and all Judah and di people wey dey stay for Jerusalem fall down before di Lord and worship di Lord.
Di Levites, from Kohath pikin dem and from Korah pikin dem, stand up to praise di Lord, di God of Israel, with very loud voice.

Dem wake up early for morning and go out to di wilderness of Tekoa, and as dem dey go out, Jehoshaphat stand and talk say, “Hear me, Judah and una wey dey stay for Jerusalem. Believe di Lord una God, and una go stand. Believe im prophets, and una go prosper.”

As e don talk with di people, e appoint dem wey go sing to di Lord and praise di glory of im holiness, as dem dey go out before di army, and say, “Give thanks to di Lord, because im mercy no dey end.”
As dem begin to sing and praise, di Lord set ambush against Ammon pikin dem, Moab and Mount Seir, wey come against Judah, and dem lose.
Because Ammon pikin dem and Moab stand up against di people wey dey stay for Mount Seir to kill and destroy dem completely, and as dem finish with di people of Seir, each one help to destroy another.
As Judah reach di watchtower for di wilderness, dem look di big crowd, and look, dead bodies dey fall for di ground, and nobody escape.

As Jehoshaphat and im people come to carry dem things, dem find among dem plenty riches and dead bodies and precious jewels, wey dem strip for dem own self, more than dem fit carry. Dem spend three days to carry di things, because e plenty.
For di fourth day dem gather for di valley of Beracah, because dem bless di Lord there. So dem call dat place di valley of Beracah till today.
Den dem return, every man of Judah and Jerusalem, with Jehoshaphat for front of dem, to go back to Jerusalem with joy, because di Lord don make dem rejoice over dem enemies.
Dem come Jerusalem with stringed instruments, harps and trumpets to di Lord house.
Di fear of God dey on all di kingdoms of dem countries as dem hear say di Lord fight against di enemies of Israel.
So Jehoshaphat kingdom dey quiet, because im God give am rest for every side.
Jehoshaphat rule over Judah. E be 35 years old as e begin to rule, and e rule 25 years for Jerusalem. Im mama name na Azubah, Shilhi daughter.
E waka for di way of im papa Asa and no turn away from am, dey do wetin right for di Lord eyes.
Still, dem no remove di high places, and di people never set dem heart to di God of dem papa dem.
Di rest of wetin Jehoshaphat do, from first to last, look, dem write dem for di history of Jehu, Hanani pikin, wey dem put for di book of di kings of Israel.
After dis, Jehoshaphat king of Judah join with Ahaziah king of Israel, wey do very wicked thing.
E join with am to make ships to go Tarshish, and dem make di ships for Ezion Geber.
Den Eliezer, Dodavahu pikin, from Mareshah, prophesy against Jehoshaphat say, “Because you don join with Ahaziah, di Lord don destroy your works.” Di ships break, so tay dem no fit go Tarshish.
Jehoshaphat die join im papa dem, and dem bury am with im papa dem for David city, and im pikin Jehoram rule for im place.
E get brothers, Jehoshaphat pikin dem: Azariah, Jehiel, Zechariah, Azariahu, Michael and Shephatiah. All dis ones na Jehoshaphat pikin dem, king of Israel.
Dem papa give dem big gifts of silver, gold and precious things, with strong cities for Judah, but di kingdom e give to Jehoram, because na im be di firstborn.
Now as Jehoram rise over im papa kingdom and make imself strong, e kill all im brothers with sword, and some of di princes of Israel too.
Jehoram be 32 years old as e begin to rule, and e rule eight years for Jerusalem.
E waka for di way of di kings of Israel, as Ahab house do, because Ahab daughter na im wife, and e do wetin bad for di Lord eyes.
Still, di Lord no wan destroy David house, because of di covenant wey e make with David, and as e promise to give lamp to am and to im pikin dem always.
For im days Edom rebel from under Judah hand and make dem own king.
Den Jehoram cross with im captains, and all im chariots with am. E stand up for night and strike di Edomites wey surround am and di captains of di chariots.
So Edom rebel from under Judah hand till today. Libnah rebel for di same time from under im hand, because e don leave di Lord, di God of im papa dem.
E make high places for di mountains of Judah too, and make di people wey dey stay for Jerusalem follow idols like prostitutes, and lead Judah go astray.
Letter come to am from Elijah di prophet say, “Dis na wetin di Lord, di God of your papa David, talk: ‘Because you no waka for di ways of Jehoshaphat your papa, or for di ways of Asa king of Judah,

but you waka for di way of di kings of Israel, and make Judah and di people wey dey stay for Jerusalem follow idols like prostitutes, like Ahab house, and you kill your brothers for your papa house, wey better pass you,
look, di Lord go strike with big plague your people, your pikin dem, your wives and all your things,
and you go get big sickness, sickness of your bowels, until your bowels fall out because of di sickness, day by day.’”
Di Lord stir up against Jehoram di spirit of di Philistines and of di Arabians wey dey beside di Ethiopians,

and dem come up against Judah, break enter am and carry away all di property wey dem find for di king house, and im pikin dem and im wives too, so tay no pikin remain for am except Jehoahaz, di youngest of im pikin dem.
After all dis, di Lord strike am for im bowels with sickness wey no get cure.
As time pass, for di end of two years, im bowels fall out because of im sickness, and e die with bad sicknesses. Im people no make fire for am, like di fire for im papa dem.
E be 32 years old as e begin to rule, and e rule for Jerusalem eight years, and e go and nobody miss am. Dem bury am for David city, but no for di tombs of di kings.

Di people wey dey stay for Jerusalem make Ahaziah, im youngest pikin, king for im place, because di band of men wey come with di Arabians to di camp don kill all di older pikin dem. So Ahaziah, Jehoram pikin, king of Judah, rule.
Ahaziah be 42 years old as e begin to rule, and e rule one year for Jerusalem. Im mama name na Athaliah, Omri daughter.
E waka for di ways of Ahab house too, because im mama be im counselor to do wickedness.
E do wetin bad for di Lord eyes, as Ahab house do, because dem be im counselors after im papa death, to im destruction.
E follow dem advice too, and go with Jehoram, Ahab pikin, king of Israel, to war against Hazael king of Syria for Ramoth Gilead, and di Syrians wound Joram.

E return to heal for Jezreel from di wounds wey dem give am for Ramah as e fight with Hazael king of Syria. Azariah, Jehoram pikin, king of Judah, go down to see Jehoram, Ahab pikin, for Jezreel, because e dey sick.
Ahaziah destruction na from God, as e go meet Joram, because as e reach, e go out with Jehoram against Jehu, Nimshi pikin, wey di Lord anoint to cut off Ahab house.
E happen say as Jehu dey carry out judgment on Ahab house, e find di princes of Judah and di pikin dem of Ahaziah brothers dey serve Ahaziah, and e kill dem.

E look for Ahaziah, and dem catch am as e dey hide for Samaria, and dem bring am to Jehu and kill am. Dem bury am, because dem talk say, “Na Jehoshaphat pikin, wey look for di Lord with all im heart.” So Ahaziah house no get power to hold di kingdom.
Now as Athaliah, Ahaziah mama, see say im pikin don die, e stand up and destroy all di royal children of Judah house.

But Jehosheba, di king daughter, take Joash, Ahaziah pikin, and steal am from among di king pikin dem wey dem dey kill, and put am and im nurse for di bedroom. Na so Jehosheba, King Jehoram daughter, Jehoiada di priest wife, and Ahaziah sister, hide am from Athaliah, so dem no kill am.
E dey with dem hide for God house six years, and Athaliah dey rule over di land.

For di seventh year Jehoiada make imself strong and take di captains of hundreds, Azariah, Jeroham pikin, Ishmael, Jehohanan pikin, Azariah, Obed pikin, Maaseiah, Adaiah pikin, and Elishaphat, Zichri pikin, enter covenant with am.
Dem go round Judah and gather di Levites from all di cities of Judah and di heads of di papa dem houses of Israel, and dem come Jerusalem.
All di gathering make covenant with di king for God house. E talk to dem say, “Look, di king pikin go rule, as di Lord talk about David pikin dem.
Dis na di thing wey una go do: one third of una, di priests and di Levites wey dey come in for Sabbath, go be gatekeepers for di doors,
and one third go dey di king house, and one third for di Foundation Gate, and all di people go dey di courts of di Lord house.
But make nobody enter di Lord house, except di priests and dem wey dey serve among di Levites. Dem go enter, because dem holy, but all di people go keep di watch of di Lord.
Di Levites go surround di king, every man with im weapons for im hand, and anybody wey enter di house, make dem kill am. Make una dey with di king as e dey come in and as e dey go out.”

So di Levites and all Judah do all wey Jehoiada di priest command. Each one take im men, di ones wey dey come in for Sabbath, with di ones wey dey go out for Sabbath, because Jehoiada di priest no release di groups.
Jehoiada di priest give di captains of hundreds di spears, di small shields and di shields wey belong to King David, wey dey God house.
E set all di people, every man with im weapon for im hand, from di right side of di house reach di left side of di house, by di altar and di house, round di king.
Den dem bring out di king pikin, put di crown on am, give am di covenant, and dem make am king. Jehoiada and im pikin dem anoint am, and dem talk say, “Make di king live long!”
As Athaliah hear di noise of di people wey dey run and dey praise di king, e come to di people for di Lord house.

E look, and look, di king dey stand by im pillar for di entrance, and di captains and di trumpets dey by di king. All di people of di land dey rejoice and dey blow trumpets, and di singers with instruments of music, and dem wey dey lead di praise singing. Den Athaliah tear im clothes and cry say, “Treason! Treason!”

Jehoiada di priest bring out di captains of hundreds wey dey over di army and talk to dem say, “Bring am out between di ranks, and anybody wey follow am, kill am with sword.” Because di priest talk say, “Make dem no kill am for di Lord house.”
So dem make way for am, and e go to di entrance of di Horse Gate for di king house, and dem kill am there.
Jehoiada make covenant between imself, all di people and di king, say dem go be di Lord people.
All di people go to di house of Baal and break am down. Dem break im altars and im images to pieces and kill Mattan, di priest of Baal, before di altars.

Jehoiada appoint di work for di Lord house under di hand of di priests, di Levites, wey David divide for di Lord house, to offer di burnt sacrifice of di Lord, as dem write am for Moses law, with rejoicing and with singing, as David order.
E set di gatekeepers for di gates of di Lord house, so that nobody wey dey unclean for anything go enter.

E take di captains of hundreds, di nobles, di governors of di people and all di people of di land, and bring di king down from di Lord house, and dem come through di Upper Gate to di king house and set di king for di throne of di kingdom.
So all di people of di land rejoice, and di city dey quiet, after dem don kill Athaliah with sword.
Joash be seven years old as e begin to rule, and e rule 40 years for Jerusalem. Im mama name na Zibiah from Beersheba.
Joash do wetin right for di Lord eyes all di days of Jehoiada di priest.
Jehoiada take two wives for am, and e born sons and daughters.
E happen after dis say Joash wan repair di Lord house.

E gather di priests and di Levites together and talk to dem say, “Go out to di cities of Judah and gather money from all Israel to repair di house of una God from year to year, and make una hurry di matter.” But di Levites no hurry am.

Di king call Jehoiada di chief and talk to am say, “Why you no ask di Levites to bring from Judah and from Jerusalem di tax of Moses, di servant of di Lord, and of di gathering of Israel, for di Tent of di Testimony?”
Because di pikin dem of Athaliah, dat wicked woman, don break open God house, and all di things wey dem give to di Lord house dem use am for di Baals.
So di king command, and dem make one chest and set am outside for di gate of di Lord house.
Dem announce for Judah and Jerusalem to bring to di Lord di tax wey Moses, God servant, put on Israel for di wilderness.
All di princes and all di people rejoice and bring am and throw am into di chest until dem finish.

E happen say any time dem bring di chest to di king officers by di Levites hand, and dem see say plenty money dey inside, di king secretary and di chief priest officer go come empty di chest, carry am and put am back for im place. Na so dem dey do day by day, and dem gather plenty money.

Di king and Jehoiada give am to dem wey dey do di work of di service of di Lord house, and dem hire masons and carpenters to repair di Lord house, and dem wey work iron and bronze to repair di Lord house too.
So di workmen work, and di work of repair go forward for dem hands, and dem set up God house as e suppose be and make am strong.

As dem finish, dem bring di rest of di money before di king and Jehoiada, and dem make vessels for di Lord house from am, vessels for service and for offering, and spoons, and vessels of gold and silver. Dem dey offer burnt sacrifice for di Lord house always all di days of Jehoiada.
But Jehoiada grow old and full of days, and e die. E be 130 years old as e die.
Dem bury am for David city among di kings, because e don do good for Israel, and toward God and im house.
Now after Jehoiada die, di princes of Judah come and bow to di king. Den di king listen to dem.
Dem leave di Lord house, di God of dem papa dem, and serve di Asherah poles and di idols, and anger come on Judah and Jerusalem because of dis dem guilt.
Still e send prophets to dem, to bring dem back to di Lord, and dem warn dem, but dem no gree listen.

God Spirit come on Zechariah, Jehoiada di priest pikin, and e stand above di people and talk to dem say, “God talk say, ‘Why una dey break di commands of di Lord, so that una no fit prosper? Because una don leave di Lord, e don leave una too.’”
Dem plan against am and stone am with stones as di king command for di court of di Lord house.
So Joash di king no remember di kindness wey Jehoiada im papa do for am, but e kill im pikin. As e dey die, e talk say, “Make di Lord look am and pay am back.”

E happen for di end of di year say di army of di Syrians come up against am, and dem come Judah and Jerusalem, destroy all di princes of di people from among di people and send all dem things to di king of Damascus.
Because di army of di Syrians come with small group of men, but di Lord give very big army into dem hand, because dem don leave di Lord, di God of dem papa dem. So dem carry out judgment on Joash.

As dem leave am, because dem leave am very sick, im own servants plan against am because of di blood of Jehoiada di priest pikin, and kill am for im bed, and e die. Dem bury am for David city, but dem no bury am for di tombs of di kings.
Dis na di ones wey plan against am: Zabad, Shimeath pikin, one Ammon woman, and Jehozabad, Shimrith pikin, one Moab woman.
As for im pikin dem, and di big burdens wey dem put on am, and di rebuilding of God house, look, dem write dem for di commentary of di book of di kings. Im pikin Amaziah rule for im place.
Amaziah be 25 years old as e begin to rule, and e rule 29 years for Jerusalem. Im mama name na Jehoaddan from Jerusalem.
E do wetin right for di Lord eyes, but no with perfect heart.
As di kingdom stand strong for am, e kill im servants wey kill di king im papa.

But e no kill dem pikin dem, but e do as dem write am for di law for di book of Moses, as di Lord command say, “Dem no go kill papa dem for pikin dem, and dem no go kill pikin dem for papa dem, but every man go die for im own sin.”

Amaziah gather Judah together and arrange dem according to dem papa dem houses, under captains of thousands and captains of hundreds, even all Judah and Benjamin. E count dem from 20 years old and above and find 300,000 chosen men, wey fit go to war, wey fit handle spear and shield.
E hire 100,000 brave and mighty men from Israel too, for 100 talents of silver.
But one man of God come to am and talk say, “King, no let di army of Israel go with you, because di Lord no dey with Israel, to say, with all Ephraim pikin dem.
But if you wan go, do am and be strong for battle, God go make you fall before di enemy, because God get power to help and to make fall.”
Amaziah talk to di man of God say, “But wetin we go do about di 100 talents wey I don give to di army of Israel?” Di man of God answer say, “Di Lord fit give you plenty more pass dis.”
Den Amaziah separate dem, di army wey come to am from Ephraim, to go home again. So dem anger burn well well against Judah, and dem return home with big anger.
Amaziah make imself strong and lead im people go di Valley of Salt, and e strike 10,000 of Seir pikin dem.
Judah pikin dem carry another 10,000 away alive, bring dem to di top of di rock and throw dem down from di top of di rock, so tay dem all break to pieces.
But di men of di army wey Amaziah send back, so that dem no go with am to battle, attack di cities of Judah from Samaria reach Beth Horon, and strike 3,000 of dem and take plenty things.
Now after Amaziah come back from di slaughter of di Edomites, e bring di gods of Seir pikin dem and set dem up as im own gods, and bow down before dem and burn incense to dem.
So di anger of di Lord burn against Amaziah, and e send prophet to am wey talk to am say, “Why you don look for di gods of di people, wey no fit save dem own people from your hand?”

As e dey talk with am, di king talk to am say, “We don make you one of di king counselors? Stop! Why dem go strike you?” Den di prophet stop, and talk say, “I know say God don decide to destroy you, because you don do dis thing and you no listen to my advice.”
Den Amaziah king of Judah take advice and send to Joash, Jehoahaz pikin, Jehu pikin, king of Israel, say, “Come, make we look each other for face.”

Joash king of Israel send to Amaziah king of Judah say, “Di thistle wey dey Lebanon send to di cedar wey dey Lebanon say, ‘Give your daughter to my pikin as wife.’ Den one wild animal wey dey Lebanon pass and trample di thistle.
You talk say, ‘Look, you don strike Edom,’ and your heart don lift you up for your boasting. Now stay for house. Why you go provoke trouble, so that you go fall, you and Judah with you?”
But Amaziah no gree hear, because na from God, so that e go give dem into dem enemies hand, because dem don look for di gods of Edom.
So Joash king of Israel go up, and e and Amaziah king of Judah look each other for face for Beth Shemesh, wey belong to Judah.
Judah lose before Israel, and dem run, every man to im tent.

Joash king of Israel catch Amaziah king of Judah, Joash pikin, Jehoahaz pikin, for Beth Shemesh, and bring am come Jerusalem and break down di wall of Jerusalem from di gate of Ephraim reach di Corner Gate, 400 cubits.
E take all di gold and silver and all di vessels wey dem find for God house with Obed Edom, and di treasures of di king house, and hostages too, and return to Samaria.
Amaziah, Joash pikin, king of Judah, live 15 years after di death of Joash, Jehoahaz pikin, king of Israel.
Di rest of wetin Amaziah do, from first to last, look, dem no write dem for di book of di kings of Judah and Israel?
From di time wey Amaziah turn away from following di Lord, dem plan against am for Jerusalem, and e run go Lachish, but dem send after am go Lachish and kill am there.
Dem bring am on horses and bury am with im papa dem for di city of Judah.
All di people of Judah take Uzziah, wey be 16 years old, and make am king for im papa Amaziah place.
E build Eloth and return am to Judah, after di king die join im papa dem.
Uzziah be 16 years old as e begin to rule, and e rule 52 years for Jerusalem. Im mama name na Jechiliah from Jerusalem.
E do wetin right for di Lord eyes, according to all wey im papa Amaziah do.
E set imself to look for God for di days of Zechariah, wey get understanding for di visions of God, and as long as e look for di Lord, God make am prosper.
E go out and fight against di Philistines, break down di wall of Gath, di wall of Jabneh and di wall of Ashdod, and e build cities for di country of Ashdod and among di Philistines.
God help am against di Philistines, and against di Arabians wey dey stay for Gur Baal and di Meunites.
Di Ammonites give Uzziah tribute, and im name spread reach di entrance of Egypt, because e grow very strong.
Uzziah build towers for Jerusalem too, for di Corner Gate and for di Valley Gate and for di turning of di wall, and e make dem strong.

E build towers for di wilderness and dig plenty wells, because e get plenty cattle, for di low land and for di plain too. E get farmers and vine dressers for di mountains and for di good fields, because e love farming.

Uzziah get army of fighting men too, wey dey go out to war by groups, according to di number of dem count wey Jeiel di secretary and Maaseiah di officer make, under di hand of Hananiah, one of di king captains.
Di whole number of di heads of di papa dem houses, even di brave and mighty men, na 2,600.
Under dem hand na army, 307,500, wey dey fight with big power to help di king against di enemy.
Uzziah prepare for dem, for all di army, shields, spears, helmets, coats of armor, bows and stones for slings.
E make machines for Jerusalem, wey skilled men design, to dey for di towers and for di walls, to shoot arrows and big stones. Im name spread far, because dem help am well well until e become strong.
But as e become strong, im heart lift up so tay e do wicked thing, and e sin against di Lord im God, because e go enter di Lord temple to burn incense for di altar of incense.
Azariah di priest go in after am, and 80 priests of di Lord wey be brave men dey with am.

Dem stand against Uzziah di king and talk to am say, “E no be for you, Uzziah, to burn incense to di Lord, but for di priests, Aaron pikin dem, wey dem don make holy to burn incense. Go out of di sanctuary, because you don sin, and e no go bring honor to you from di Lord God.”
Den Uzziah vex, and e get censer for im hand to burn incense, and as e dey vex with di priests, leprosy break out for im forehead before di priests for di Lord house, beside di altar of incense.
Azariah di chief priest and all di priests look am, and look, e get leprosy for im forehead, and dem push am out quick quick from there. Even e imself hurry go out, because di Lord don strike am.

Uzziah di king get leprosy till di day of im death, and e dey stay for separate house, because e get leprosy, and dem cut am off from di Lord house. Jotham im pikin dey over di king house and dey judge di people of di land.
Di rest of wetin Uzziah do, from first to last, Isaiah di prophet, Amoz pikin, write am.
So Uzziah die join im papa dem, and dem bury am with im papa dem for di field of burial wey belong to di kings, because dem talk say, “E get leprosy.” Im pikin Jotham rule for im place.
Jotham be 25 years old as e begin to rule, and e rule 16 years for Jerusalem. Im mama name na Jerushah, Zadok daughter.
E do wetin right for di Lord eyes, according to all wey im papa Uzziah do, but e no enter di Lord temple. Di people still dey do wicked things.
E build di Upper Gate of di Lord house, and for di wall of Ophel e build plenty.
E build cities for di hill country of Judah too, and for di forests e build castles and towers.

E fight with di king of Ammon pikin dem and win dem. Di Ammon pikin dem give am dat same year 100 talents of silver, 10,000 measures of wheat and 10,000 of barley. Di Ammon pikin dem give am so much for di second year too and for di third.
So Jotham become mighty, because e arrange im ways before di Lord im God.
Di rest of wetin Jotham do, and all im wars and im ways, look, dem write dem for di book of di kings of Israel and Judah.
E be 25 years old as e begin to rule, and e rule 16 years for Jerusalem.
Jotham die join im papa dem, and dem bury am for David city, and im pikin Ahaz rule for im place.
